contract.task_clause:
Which of the following applies to an accountant conducting a review of interim financial information?
Option A: The accountant must indicate in the report those circumstances in which generally accepted accounting principles have not been consistently observed in the current period in relation to the preceding period.
Option B: The accountant must express an opinion on the financial statements taken as a whole.
Option C: The accountant must maintain independence in mental attitude in all matters relating to the engagement.
Option D: The accountant must obtain sufficient appropriate evidence by performing procedures to afford a reasonable basis for an opinion.
